notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Lord of Tresserhorn.
Lord of Tresserhorn does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Lord of Tresserhorn.
description:
Deal combat damage with Lord of Tresserhorn, causing target opponent to get twelve poison counters.
The opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
